about: PROPOSED, UNSIGNED. One Proofline task, XC-57, part of the 'cover ALL' decomposition (XC-54 to XC-78) drafted on 2026-10-25 from public sources. Nothing here is binding and vv does not read this file. It becomes part of the contract only when the owner merges it into proofline.json and re-signs it with the owner key pinned in guard/owner.pub. Every criterion except scope, pushed and the unchanged-suite guards fails on the v1.6.0 tree. Evidence is testnet-only, loopback-only and verify-only unless the task says otherwise; hosted facilitators are never called. Estimated effort: 3-4 days.

not_contract_tasks.keys: Throwaway testnet keys and faucet tokens are created on the owner's machine and live in X402C_KEYS outside the repository. No spend, no mainnet.
not_contract_tasks.disclosure: A failing third-party column is reported to that project privately first (SECURITY.md). Until the window clears its row says 'under disclosure' with no per-check detail.

tasks.title: Parity backtest on historical cross-SDK fixes, and a nightly read-only shadow run against upstream main
tasks.description: tools/parity_backtest.py checks out each listed upstream commit pair in a scratch clone and runs XC-56. The result is the adoption argument in numbers: how many of the Foundation's own paired fixes the oracle would have caught at PR time. The nightly workflow is read-only (contents: read) and only commits its own report to this repository.

criteria.statement: Replayed on the parent and merge commits of each paired upstream fix in docs/parity/backtest.json (at least: #3668/#3901/#3902, #3877/#3881, #3878/#3884, #3542/#3543), the oracle reports a divergence before and parity after, for every pair
A scheduled workflow runs the oracle against upstream main daily, read-only, and commits the dated report; it never comments, opens issues or calls any write API

verifier.cmd: python3 -c "import sys,re;s=open('.github/workflows/parity-nightly.yml').read();ok=('schedule' in s) and not re.search(r'issues: write|pull-requests: write|gh (issue|pr) (create|comment)',s);sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)"

criteria.statement: The nightly report maps each divergence to the open upstream drift issue item that names it, when one exists (read-only GitHub search), and says 'no matching issue' otherwise
Every changed file is inside this task's scope

stop_rules: If a criterion cannot pass, STOP and report what blocks it, what was tried and what is needed. Never weaken a criterion, skip a test or raise a timeout to make it pass.

Testnet only: never use a mainnet CAIP-2 id, never fund a key with anything but testnet faucet tokens, never call a hosted facilitator; every facilitator under test is the owner's own instance on 127.0.0.1.
A failing third-party result is not published with per-check detail until SECURITY.md's disclosure window clears; if a criterion would need that detail to pass, STOP and report.
